name: Billiard
description: The rays of a ray field as particles at a time, like a 3D billiard: press Play to animate, or connect a time (a slider scrubs it) for a frozen frame.

inputParameters.name: ray_field
inputParameters.description: The ray field, from Ray Field.

inputParameters.name: time
inputParameters.description: Time in ms. Alone: the frame at that time (a slider scrubs). With Play: where playback stops (default: the end).

inputParameters.name: play
inputParameters.description: Press (or turn a Boolean Toggle on) to play from 0 to time (default: the end of the ray field) and hold the last frame; pressing again restarts.

inputParameters.name: speed
inputParameters.description: Milliseconds of sound per second of playback (default: the whole ray field in 10 s).

outputParameters.name: particles
outputParameters.description: The position of every ray that has not ended yet at the time, as points.

outputParameters.name: trails
outputParameters.description: The rays from the source up to the time, as polylines.
